regime: Stabilization day. The indices kept falling overnight then reversed and bought the dip through the US session. NQ reclaimed its trend stop intraday but closed slightly red (-0.30%) and still below its average; ES lagged and stayed short (-0.34%). Crude ripped +4.26% and flipped its trend long on Iran-Oman headlines, while gold cooled -0.20% and flipped its short-term stop short after its +4% surge. The VIX eased again to about 15.1 and the 10-year yield ticked up near 4.69% ahead of Friday's July jobs report.
summary: Stabilization day. Overnight, the indices kept falling from yesterday's reversal, with NQ sinking to 29,241, then they turned and bought the dip through the US session. NQ reclaimed its trend stop intraday and closed only slightly red at 29,504.5 (-0.30%), while ES lagged and stayed under its stop at 7,731.75 (-0.34%). The Dow tagged a fresh record even as tech gave back a little of yesterday's rally. Weekly jobless claims edged up to 199,000 but the labor picture stayed steady into Friday's big July jobs report. The clean movers were elsewhere: crude ripped +4.26% to 78.25 on reports of Iran-Oman talks and flipped its trend long, while gold cooled -0.20% to 4,267.5 after its +4% surge and flipped its short-term stop short. The 10-year yield ticked up near 4.69% and the VIX eased again to about 15.1. This read as the market catching its breath before the jobs number.
psychology: The trap today was the word 'long.' NQ's trend stop flipped back to long during the session, and it is tempting to read that as a green light. Look closer. That flip happened because the falling short stop ratcheted down until price met it, not because price closed back above its own average. NQ still finished below its 29,540 AVWAP and closed red. A flip earned on a technicality is weaker than a flip earned on a clean reclaim. The skill is to know the difference and wait for the confirmation, which here is a two-close reclaim of 29,540. The same patience theme showed up all day: gold rewarded the ones who did not chase 4,300 after a 4% run, and crude rewarded the ones who waited at the range edge. Let the level confirm.

Plan your exposure into the number and check your prop-firm blackout rules.
